title: Help on what tools to use to finish my game
author: ode2009
selftext: So im old scholl almos 50, i love arcade old games, after seeing many imaginary hd remakes i decided to create my own. Circus Charlie, im halfway there, ive been using codex and claude, currently using  claude fable. But both suck at making sprites. Im looking for free tools that can help me generate better sprites, like i said, the game its almost done, but the characters movements dont look right. It amazes me how old arcade games managed to make better animations with such low space and memory, so that being said , i wonder if anyone here can give me some advice on free tools that can help me on this. If anyone cares [https://github.com/abispac/CircusCharlieHD](https://github.com/abispac/CircusCharlieHD) i still need to update it to the last changes but so far i like how its looking. Any advice its truly apreciated.
